On the ANA GE90 (knav 7A _9), the mark is a small 'GE' wordmark followed by the swirled GE script roundel. The roundel has curling swash strokes inside the circle, not letters. The position and size are right.
evidence: ref/web/exterior/b5_knav_ANA77W_7A_GE90_takeoff_9.jpg (255-335, 845-870: wordmark on the left, swirl roundel on the right)
src/11_exterior.js line ~340: the three block-letter polylines
issues.fix: In the monogram block, replace the 'for (const sw of [[...G...],[...E...],[...bar...]])' loop with 4 swash strokes inside the ring: for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const a0 = k * Math.PI / 2 + 0.4, pts = []; for (let t = 0; t <= 1.0001; t += 0.1) { const r = 0.20 * (1 - 0.7 * t), a = a0 + 2.4 * t; pts.push(at(Math.cos(a) * r * side, Math.sin(a) * r)); } B.add(gTube(pts, 0.02, 4, false), rot, ge); }. Then add the wordmark: the old G/E polylines scaled by 0.45 and shifted by u = -0.40 * side (forward of the ring, per knav _9), with tube radius 0.011.

issues.detail: canoes (flap-track fairings): tone seen from above
issues.problem: In w19A the outboard canoes behind the TE render as near-black 'shark teeth', #33353b-#3a404b against wing skin #8f99a7 (about 0.38 of the skin). From the same kind of window view in KN41, the canoes sample #8596b2 / #798da8 against skin #b9c1ce (about 0.7) and read as light pods. The baked flank grade, 0.55 + 0.45*((n.y+1)/2)^1.3 (0.73 on a vertical flank), stacks with the sun-side shading, so the inboard flanks visible from the A side go charcoal. The B side (w26K) is acceptable: lit #a3a7ab / keel #7e7f81.
issues.fix: In the canoe shadeVerts (vC..vN), keep the grade only on the underside: (p, n) => n[1] >= 0 ? 1 : 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.pow(1 + n[1], 1.3). Vertical flanks then stay at 1.0 and the keel stays at about 0.6, which keeps _7250's 0.55 belly ratio. If the flank is still below 0.6 of the skin, the lighting owner should check the exterior sun/sky term on near-vertical normals (shared issue).

issues.problem: The keel is now right. The upper line, though, stays at the wing lower surface minus 0.03 m per m, so the point sits at the very top of the pod. Also, d = 0.85*rd + 0.04 and w = 0.46*rw + 0.03 leave a 0.10 x 0.14 m blunt end that reads as a cut face in c_canoe_side. In _7250 (380,930) the upper line falls visibly toward a sharp tip about a third of the way down.
issues.fix: topAt for xn > te: ... - 0.18 * Math.pow((xn - te(cs)) / (x1 + RE - te(cs)), 1.4) instead of 0.03 per m. In sec(), scale the floors by the size, d = 0.85 * rd + 0.04 * Math.min(1, rd * 3) and likewise w, so the end-cap sections reach about 0.03 m.

issues.problem: (1) The spanwise skin splice at 45 % chord follows le + 0.45*(te - le), so it kinks at the TE (Yehudi) break and draws a visibly bowed S-curve (c_wing_panel centre; w17A from (565,240) to (620,560)). Real skin splices follow the spars and are straight lines. (2) The skin is still CG-clean. KN41 shows rivet rows that read as dotted lines at (0-500, 700-860), panel tone steps, and dark grime along the flap TE. At this range the model's skin reads as one flat grey with no wear.
issues.fix: mid = (s) => lerp(lef(4) + 0.45 * (pwl(WING.te, 4) - lef(4)), lef(29) + 0.45 * (pwl(WING.te, 29) - lef(29)), (s - 4) / 25), a straight line between the end points. In paintVerts, add TE grime: f *= uv[0] > 0.9 ? lerp(1, 0.86, (uv[0] - 0.9) / 0.1) : 1. Raise mv to [0.86, 0.88, 0.94] on flaps only (xn > tE - 0.9) to get KN41's spoiler-to-flap step.
